description:
Hlala uxhumekile futhi uvikelekile nge-Life360, inkampani yokugcina yokuxhumana nomndeni nezokuphepha. Nge-Life360 unendawo yawo wonke umuntu (nayo yonke into) ebaluleke kakhulu entendeni yesandla sakho. Lokho kusho ukuthi ungakhathazeki kancane futhi kunciphile ukuthi “uphi?” imibhalo. Kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-66 emhlabeni jikelele, i-Life360 ihlanganiswe nendwangu yempilo yabo yansuku zonke, yenza kube lula ukuthi baxhumana futhi baxhumane kanjani.

I-Life360 iyinketho ye-premium yabasebenzisi abafuna ukuthuthukisa ulwazi lwabo ngendawo ngokuvikeleka okungenakuhlulwa nezici zokuvikela zemindeni, abangani nokuningi.

Ngaphezu kokugxila kwezokuphepha, abalandeleli be-Life360's Tile banweba lolu xhumo ezilwaneni ezifuywayo kanye nazo zonke izinto zakho ezibalulekile ezifana 🔑 Okhiye, 👛 Wallets, 🧳 Imithwalo, 🚲 Amabhayisikili.

Ubulungu be-Life360 buhlanganisa izici ezibalulekile zokuphepha ezifana:
🆘 Izaziso ze-SOS: Thumela izexwayiso ezithulile ngendawo yakho enembile kubangani, amalungu omndeni, abathintwayo abezimo eziphuthumayo, nabaphenduli.
🚓 24/7 I-Emergency Dispatch: Silapha ngenxa yabathandekayo bakho, sihlale sikulungele ukuphendula, ngisho nalapho ungakwazi ukushaya ucingo.
🕵️‍♂️ Ukuvikelwa Kokwebiwa Kobunikazi: Vikela ulwazi lwedijithali olubucayi lwelungu ngalinye lomndeni, lusekelwe isevisi yokubuyisela amagilavu ​​amhlophe.
⚠️ Usizo Oluseceleni Komgwaqo: Ukudonsa kwamahhala, ama-jumpstart, izinguquko zamasondo, usizo lokukhiya, ukufaka amafutha nokunye.

Nge-Life360, ungakwazi:
☑️ Thola abangani bakho
☑️ Thola umndeni wakho
☑️ Thola izingane zakho
☑️ Thola ifoni yakho
☑️ Landelela yonke into ebaluleke kakhulu

Landa manje ukuze ufinyelele:
📍 Ukwabiwa Kwendawo
🚗 Ukutholwa kokuphahlazeka
🔔 Izaziso Ezihlakaniphile
📌 Umlando wendawo
🏠 Izaziso zendawo
🆘 Izexwayiso Zosizo ze-SOS
✈️ Izaziso Zokuhamba Kwendiza
💬 ... nokuningi!

Gcina amathebhu kumalungu akho omndeni njengoba eza futhi ephuma ezindaweni ezibalulekile njengasekhaya, esikoleni nasemsebenzini.

I-Life360 Silver - Yenza ukuphepha kwakho kube lula ngezici ezifana nalezi:
▪️ Izindawo ezi-2 ezinezaziso ezingenamkhawulo 🔔
▪️ Izinsuku ezi-2 zomlando wendawo 📌
▪️ Ukutholwa kokuphahlazeka 💥🚗
▪️ Isifinyezo Sokushayela Komndeni 
▪️ Izaziso Zokuphulwa Kwedatha 
▪️ Izexwayiso Zosizo ze-SOS Ngesikhathi Sezimo Eziphuthumayo 🆘

I-Life360 Gold* - Gcina umndeni wakho uphephile lapho usohambeni ngazo zonke izici ze-Life360 Silver, kanye:
- Izinsuku ezingu-30 zomlando wendawo 📌
- Izaziso Zendawo Engenamkhawulo 🔔
- Imibiko yomshayeli ngamunye 
- Ukutholwa kokuphahlazeka ngokuthunyelwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo nokusekelwa kwe-ejenti ebukhoma 🚓
- 24/7 Usizo Lomgwaqo ⚠️
- $250 Ekuvikelweni Kwefoni Ebiwe 
- Ukuvikelwa Kokwebiwa Kwe-ID kanye Nezaziso Zokwephulwa Kwedatha
- $25,000 ku-Stolen Fund Reimbursement 

I-Life360 Platinum* - Lungiselela noma yini, noma yikuphi, ngazo zonke izici ze-Life360 Gold, kanye:
- $ 1 million ekubuyiselweni kweStolen Fund 
- 50 miles of Free towing 
- $500 Ekuvikelweni Kwefoni Ebiwe 
- Ukusekelwa Kwezokuvakasha Ngosizo Lwezinhlekelele
- Ukwesekwa Kwezokwelapha 🩺

Landa i-Life360 ukuze uthole ukuthula kwengqondo, ukwazi ukuthi obathandayo nezinto ezibalulekile zivikelekile. Joyina izigidi ezithemba i-Life360 ngokwabelana ngendawo.

https://www.life360.com/privacy_policy/
https://www.life360.com/terms_of_use/

Incazelo Yezimvume Zohlelo Lokusebenza [Izimvume Ongazikhethela]
 ○ Ikhamera: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela ikhamera yomsebenzisi ukuze luvumele abasebenzisi ukuthi bathathe izithombe noma amavidiyo kuhlelo lokusebenza.
○ Indawo: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela ulwazi lwendawo ukuze luvumele abasebenzisi ukuthi babelane ngolwazi lwendawo kwamanye amalungu wombuthano.
○ Imakrofoni: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela imakrofoni ukuze luvumele abasebenzisi ukuthi barekhode futhi babelane ngamamemo ezwi.
○ Umculo nomsindo: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela emculweni nomsindo ukuze ludlale umculo nomsindo.
○ Amadivayisi aseduze: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela kumadivayisi aseduze ukuze lithole, lixhume futhi linqume indawo ehlobene yamadivayisi aseduze ngokusebenzisa i-Bluetooth.
○ Izaziso: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela isaziso ukuze luthumele isaziso kubasebenzisi.
○ Ifoni: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela ocingweni lomsebenzisi ukuze luvumele abasebenzisi ukuthi benze amakholi efoni ohlelweni lokusebenza
○ Izithombe namavidiyo: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela izithombe namavidiyo ukuze luvumele abasebenzisi ukuthi babuke izithombe namavidiyo ohlelweni lokusebenza.
○ Umsebenzi womzimba: Uhlelo lokusebenza lufinyelela imisebenzi yomzimba ukuze libale futhi lithole imicimbi yokushayela, njengesivinini sokushayela, ukusetshenziswa kwamakhefu, nokutholwa kwezingozi. 

Usengasebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ngisho noma ugodla izimvume ozikhethele. Nokho, izici zohlelo lokusebenza ezidinga imvume zingase zingatholakali esimweni esinjalo.
